implementationScope: package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 incremental session with semantic-unit transport, canonical monotone progression, dynamic table ownership, actual-only coefficient planes, exact current Huffman payloads, packed progression, fused render staging and final-only EOI sample-plane materialization that releases coefficient/control state before RGB allocation

cases.mechanismPressure: every-scan control proves v17 leaves preview/render resource authority unchanged while publishing final-sample geometry for the same source
576x576 final-only case makes tight 4:2:0 spatial samples dominate EOI materialization, proving coefficients and RGB no longer coexist
restart-heavy final-only case proves EOI sample materialization is orthogonal to split restart-marker suspension and rollback authority

requiredInvariants: All v16 transport, table ownership, coefficient geometry, packed progression, canonical scan semantics, fused chroma-to-RGB, restart, preview and EOI final-ready invariants remain unchanged.

Tight final sample payload equals width*height + 2*chromaWidth*chromaHeight for the qualified 4:2:0 geometry. The sample materialization scratch is exactly 384 bytes: one 64-entry Int32 IDCT workspace plus one 64-entry UInt16 quantization widening table; progressive smoothing scratch is not live.

For final-only cadence, validated EOI and same-window trailing-byte checks complete before the 414-byte transport backing is released. Tight Y/Cb/Cr sample allocation then coexists with maximum persistent coefficient/control authority plus 384 bytes scratch, but not transport or RGB.

The materialize-and-release helper returns only after coefficient/Huffman/control state is released; RGB allocation therefore coexists with tight sample planes but not decoder state. Samples are released after RGB conversion, so final-ready retained remains exactly RGB bytes.
Final-only operation peak is max(transition, entropy rollback, Huffman mutation, persistentState+finalSamples+384, finalSamples+RGB). It is not persistent+RGB+RenderArena.
The every-completed-scan tiny control retains the v16 operation peak 7,743 bytes and all ten stable previews; v17 does not change preview cadence resource authority.

The 576x576 final-only case has 497,664 bytes of tight samples and operation peak 1,495,840 bytes, down from v16 2,009,022, while maximum retained authority remains 998,206 and final-ready retained remains 995,328 RGB bytes.

The restart64 final-only case has 6,144 bytes of tight samples and operation peak 21,280 bytes, down from v16 30,142, while maximum retained authority remains 15,166 and final-ready retained remains 12,288 RGB bytes.
Schema17 validation reads corresponding v16 reports: persistent/max-retained/final RGB must match; final-only peaks must strictly decrease while every-scan peak must remain equal.
This phase split does not claim allocator headers, Swift object overhead, physical RSS, other sampling modes, embedded color-management semantics, or a public representation-transfer contract.
